title: How to "DELETE" reviews through the API using Zapier
text:
## How to "DELETE" reviews through the API using Zapier
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000101566
This article shows an example of how a Google Spreadsheet can be used to delete a review for members on a site using the site's API.

## Checklist Before Moving Forward With This Example
1) Make sure to generate a unique API Key using the documentation down below as a guideline. Please make sure to save the API Key in a safe place as it is not accessible after it has been created:
How To Generate an API Key
2) Make sure to have a Google Spreadsheet ready. This spreadsheet should have at least one row of the review information shown below:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12150394851/original/Af9QQ7ybianIuZAjzXMaZFLiWI942ZPzyg.png?1727962838 | alt: ]
Please note the following required fields in order to delete a member review:
review_id
review_title
Find the ID of the Review in Interactions » Member Reviews :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12149716628/original/2Xd0hIE5UCqdsqDLWViwvDBGQdFkOsrjow.png?1726764075 | alt: ]

## Connecting Google Sheets with Zapier
Log in to the Zapier account and click on + Create and click on Zaps :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12149715372/original/IFqb_2Gl6MSr_sn5mI8HOeluIAr3VGauCw.png?1726762728 | alt: ]
or Click on Zaps
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12149715300/original/w6uczFGeMLRqpd9dBmGzkuo4FPYSoeS7KA.png?1726762649 | alt: ]
Click on + Create then click on New Zap:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12149715295/original/0ksTQIwl9I_Es1ztkoa3hG6U8dG_ezaQDw.png?1726762630 | alt: ]
Click on Trigger and search for Google Sheet:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12149196948/original/nZZXjY2yCyB6EscuKzQTJCn7s43jpjdV1g.gif?1725922583 | alt: ]
The Trigger event should be set to "New or Updated Spreadsheet Row." After logging into the Google account, clicking on "Continue" will proceed.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12149715953/original/RMLfdTyU45RSX8GLR1r5vEuiygt6psSKoQ.png?1726763377 | alt: ]
Select the Spreadsheet that has the review information with the respective Worksheet. If necessary, select a Trigger Column or leave as "any column" and click on Continue:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12149716027/original/99_YhtMkr5eH1mRvixi_tCKZGGYF9hYddQ.png?1726763434 | alt: ]
Click on Continue with Selected Record. The Spreadsheet information will display as a preview:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12149716067/original/L_slaMMsgoELr_QJMxTa8jrzT-hGq0obGg.png?1726763495 | alt: ]

## Connecting the API with Zapier
A new set of options will appear, select the option for Brilliant Directories:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12149197936/original/HbY9BUDAxqa5-u31-Gp34W4D-MEdmwtmXg.gif?1725924212 | alt: ]
The Action Event should be set to "Delete Review." A Brilliant Directories account can be chosen if one has been used before, or a new account can be connected.
If an account is already, skip down to FILL IN THE BLANK.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12149716313/original/iyIBHSgnaVpcAvD876EGLBfQOcOm6hQBVQ.png?1726763644 | alt: ]
If this is the first time, click on Connect a new account and a popup will show up. Add the website URL and the API Key , and click Yes, Continue to Brilliant Directories:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12149716421/original/6cEfB5JZYUg2fOWMUm1IQO2__hquVTsQNA.png?1726763826 | alt: ]
Once finished, click Continue.

## Configuring the Review Information
Click on Continue.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12149716578/original/Ucl8zHqHO_o1DhPLqsXhzqs7x_30GKxJgw.png?1726764003 | alt: ]
Click on the vertical dots and select Custom.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12150395103/original/ghyexedps4uy8qHXikWkn-yE5V3zJ-Y4AQ.png?1727963061 | alt: ]
Select review_id. Hit Continue.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12150395703/original/BFhOVkq1DkbsYXof-Zrgj89dYKZnatRk-w.png?1727963525 | alt: ]
Click on Test Step:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12149716608/original/ypl6jDPhispYqee56YoKbrVaYlX64Y5lsQ.png?1726764041 | alt: ]
The record is now deleted, click on Publish to have the Zap active.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12149716612/original/eJALotOmj1LeaLh8-phL01hfjJGlEW45_g.png?1726764051 | alt: ]
Add a name to the Zap to find it easily:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12149718019/original/dqnNTg4nRW5o32H8dpY7Xgo1ACDO7tvu1g.png?1726765488 | alt: ]
If done correctly, the review will be removed in the Interactions » Member Reviews :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12149198365/original/VBQkk_3w9HMYWyH7i7jY8qI8r-6eeiChmA.png?1725925246 | alt: ]
Click on Transfer existing data is there is a need to delete the reviews right away. For automatic deletion, simply waiting a few minutes for the trigger "New or Updated Spreadsheet Row" to take action is all that's needed.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12149720915/original/g0L337R9nxxuHQJgrXrN-9gqc6-XwghjmQ.png?1726769130 | alt: ]
